description: Canonical DC323 command-family implementation and coverage requirements

coverage_levels.direct: Firmware-free pixel/status assertions aimed at this command family
coverage_levels.integration: Native firmware output and command activity jointly validate the family
coverage_levels.negative: Confirms an unsupported or no-draw form does not produce an unintended effect
coverage_levels.observed: Command occurs in a trace but the test does not assert its semantics

families.title: Command-zero abort
families.encoding: command = 0000
families.remaining: Exact asynchronous abort/FIFO timing is unresolved.

families.title: Selected Viper register load
families.encoding: command = 0180-019F
families.remaining: No known functional gap in the retained per-plane model.

families.title: Normal raster with constant source
families.encoding: op=2 D=1 S1=0 S2=0, X-control mode 00
families.remaining: Exact traversal direction controls remain.

families.title: Normal raster with bitmap source 1
families.encoding: op=2 D=1 S1=1 S2=0, X-control mode 00, bitmap source
families.remaining: Overlap traversal direction remains.

families.title: Normal raster with E49 character-ROM source 1
families.encoding: op=2 D=1 S1=1 S2=0, X-control mode 00, source Y bit 12
families.remaining: A firmware-free character-ROM pixel test would strengthen coverage.

families.title: Normal-mode hole filling
families.encoding: op=2 D=1 S1=0 S2=0, X-control mode 00, HF=1
families.remaining: Source-coupled holes, complement corrections, and exact silicon edge cases are unresolved.

families.title: Normal raster with nonzero indexes
families.encoding: op=2, X-control index enabled, any old/new index nonzero
families.remaining: Old/new selection follows the live DC7051 raster line; bitmap scrolling itself is still applied atomically at frame service.

families.title: Programmable Bresenham error offsets
families.encoding: register 2F offsets destination slow/edge A; register 30 offsets destination fast/edge B
families.remaining: Extreme adjustment overflow behavior has not been compared with physical silicon.

families.title: Raster operation with destination disabled
families.encoding: op=2 D=0
families.remaining: Observed firmware forms appear diagnostic; no visible operation is established.

families.title: Reserved X-control mode 01
families.encoding: op=2 D=1, X-control mode 01
families.remaining: No drawing behavior is inferred without hardware evidence.

families.title: Linear-pattern raster with source 1
families.encoding: op=2 D=1 S1=1 S2=0, X-control mode 10
families.remaining: No known functional gap; exact sampling artifacts remain subject to physical-silicon comparison.

families.title: Source-free linear-pattern encoding
families.encoding: op=2 D=1 S1=0 S2=0, X-control mode 10
families.remaining: Dragon defines linear-pattern mode around source 1; the no-source form is an illegal command combination with undefined hardware results.

families.title: X/Y two-edge fill
families.encoding: op=2 D=1 S1=0 S2=0, X-control mode 11, baseline=0
families.remaining: Unequal and crossing edges execute; complement-mode vertex-doubling corrections remain.

families.title: X/Y baseline fill
families.encoding: op=2 D=1 S1=0 S2=0, X-control mode 11, baseline=1
families.remaining: Hardware comparison and complement interactions remain.

families.title: Chained polygon fill edges
families.encoding: successive op=2 fill commands without origin reload
families.remaining: Independent edge expiration and crossing continuation are implemented; complement-mode vertex-doubling corrections remain.

families.title: Raster source 2
families.remaining: Source-2-only addressing/fills and dual-source CSR routing are implemented; exact Viper word-pipeline, delay-register, and multiple-driver behavior remains.

families.title: X-mode bitmap-to-processor transfer
families.remaining: Six-entry FIFO flow and staged command status are modeled; exact per-memory-cycle transfer cadence remains provisional.

families.title: X-mode processor-to-bitmap transfer
families.remaining: Six-entry FIFO back-pressure and asynchronous service are modeled; exact per-memory-cycle transfer cadence remains provisional.

families.title: Z-mode processor/bitmap transfer
families.encoding: op=3 with Z-mode selection
families.remaining: One-bit Viper plane addressing, Z blocks, and foreground/background PTB paths are implemented; low-resolution subplanes and the board-inaccessible upper I/D byte remain.

families.title: Other operation-3 source/destination forms
families.encoding: op=3 excluding established X- and Z-mode PBT/PTB forms
families.remaining: No defined behavior has been established.

families.title: Frame-serviced vertical scroll/erase
families.encoding: register 14 load, executed by frame event
families.remaining: Queueing, exact edge masks, event phase, and status timing remain provisional.
